sections.text:
Title 59. Professions and Occupations
§59-1698. Limit on apprentice electricians working under a journeyman or contractor.

No more than three apprentice electricians shall work under the supervision of a single journeyman or contractor.
Added by Laws 2018, c. 17, § 2, eff. Nov. 1, 2018.
